comment: Two dialogs that have to fit. At 1920 by 1080 and a UI scale of 1, Image, Colour Space opens as tall as its drawing and is then dragged by its corner grip as far up as it goes, to the floor it declares: the three buttons have to stay inside the window and the page has to scroll. Then New Module at a UI scale of 2 on 1280 by 800 with the Font size at 1.5, where its hint about the modules folder runs to more lines than the 640 by 335 below the bar holds: the Cancel and Create row has to stay inside the window, and the click on Cancel says where it is.
